body.message:
We truly understand your situation and appreciate your cooperation. However, we are unable to update the booking details or proceed with the extension without receiving the full payment.

As a gesture of goodwill, and based on your confirmation that the payment would be completed on 16th, we made an exception and extended your stay without receiving the payment.

We kindly request you to complete the outstanding payment at your earliest convenience, as we need to confirm the payment with our Finance Team and finalize the extension accordingly.
